title: 登录
summary: 「做个登录页」只说了有表单。先定是居中卡片、左右分栏、沉浸背景、角色入口，还是分步。
summaryEn: “Make a login page” only says there is a form. First pick a centered card, a split, immersive, a role gate, or steps.
asks: 登录是一张卡、分栏、沉浸、角色入口，还是分步？
asksEn: Is login a card, a split, immersive, a role gate, or steps?

links.when: 登录卡怎么摆不是整页骨架
links.whenEn: how the login card sits is not the page skeleton
login is not a selling hero
